relations: As the firework cluster drifts upward, the lower trails of the central pink mass fade out.
New spherical peony bursts emerge and widen on the left, right, and top right.
A small central white burst dims and is absorbed into the surrounding red sphere.
The bottom smoke bank persists while its illuminated color shifts between pink and pale yellow.
caption: The video captures a static nighttime fireworks display over a dark horizon dotted with scattered ground lights and a low bank of illuminated smoke. A large overlapping cluster of bursts fills the upper two-thirds of the frame. It combines an orange-red sphere on the left, a magenta-purple sphere at the top right, green bursts, and a bright pink mass in the middle, with several white and gold peony shells throughout. The cluster drifts upward as the lower trails of the pink mass fade. New spherical peony bursts emerge: an orange-white shell on the left grows into a full sphere, a white shell on the right enlarges, and a red-gold shell appears at the top right and widens. A small white burst near the center dims and is absorbed into the surrounding red sphere. The smoke bank at the bottom persists, its lit color shifting between pink and pale yellow.
